name: Nationalparkhaus Matrei
kurzbeschreibung: The modern Nationalparkhaus in Matrei in Osttirol serves as the premier visitor hub for Hohe Tauern National Park, featuring interactive exhibits and guided ranger programs.
preis: Adults € 6.00, children free (discounts with guest card)
oeffnungszeiten: Open year-round; Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00, in summer daily 09:00-18:00
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Nationalparkhaus Matrei in East Tirol serves as the state-of-the-art flagship visitor and information centre for the Hohe Tauern National Park. Situated in the market town of Matrei, this striking architectural complex seamlessly combines modern environmental education with multimedia storytelling and captivating natural history exhibitions. The centerpiece of the facility is the acclaimed permanent exhibition titled 'Tauernblicke – Moments of Wonder', guiding visitors on a sensory journey through all altitudinal zones and fragile habitats of Central Europe's largest nature reserve. From verdant valley meadows and fragrant stone pine forests to the glacier-clad summits of the Großglockner and Großvenediger, ecological interrelationships are brought to life for guests of all ages.

Route & Anforderungen

Visiting the Nationalparkhaus is completely barrier-free, making it an ideal destination for families with strollers, senior citizens, and travelers seeking an enriching all-weather activity. A well-organized self-guided tour winds across multiple spacious levels with hands-on discovery stations, cinematic projections, and an immersive 360-degree cinema. Touring the exhibits generally takes between one and two hours. Children can participate in engaging discovery games tracking the 'Big Five' of the Alps: the alpine ibex, chamois, bearded vulture, golden eagle, and marmot. The on-site ranger desk provides mountaineers with up-to-the-minute trail conditions, avalanche advisories, and weather forecasts.

Besuch & Anreise

The facility is centrally located in Matrei in Osttirol, conveniently accessible right off the Felbertauern federal highway (B108). Dedicated free parking for cars and touring coaches is available directly at the building. Via public transportation, regular regional buses connect Matrei with the regional railway hub in Lienz and the Pinzgau valley in Salzburg, with stops located mere steps from the main entrance. The visitor centre is open year-round, featuring a boutique national park shop stocked with local artisan goods and hiking guides.

Tipps

Take the opportunity to book expert ranger-led wilderness treks and birdwatching safaris into neighboring valleys directly at the information counter. Another must-see highlight is viewing the award-winning panoramic nature documentaries showcased inside the centre's high-definition auditorium.
